availability.note: GWM AU Ora 5 page on 2026-11-26: two grades, Lux $33,990 and Ultra $36,990 driveaway, 'Price is for private buyers in VIC', 2026 build; configurator renders client-side. CarExpert pricing page lists the same two grades

listPrice.note: GWM VIC private-buyer driveaway $33,990 (no in-words list price from GWM). (33990 - 958.80) / 1.042 = 31,700; round-trip through calc/onroad.js driveAwayPrice gives $33,989.55. GoAuto calls it national driveaway, so the figure may be a flat national campaign price rather than a VIC calculation; no independent on-road estimate could be found. Rejected: Zecar '$33,990 RRP before on-road costs' (equals the driveaway); CarExpert model page '$32,490 before on-road costs' for the Lux (unsourced database figure; its VIC driveaway would be $34,735, $745 above GWM's). Ignored the extra $1,000-off campaign ending 30 Nov 2026 Re-derived 2026-11-27 for VIC rego $958.80 (was 31,775 at $880; round trip 33990.20).

batteryKwh.note: EV Database NZ (same AU/NZ Lux/Ultra spec): usable 58.3 kWh, nominal 60 kWh (asterisked as estimate). GWM prints 58.33 kWh, i.e. the usable figure. ev-database.org (UK) does not list the Ora 5

rangeKm.note: km77 (Spain, same 150 kW, 225/60R18 car): 435 km WLTP. GWM AU says 'up to 435km WLTC' (WLTC is the WLTP cycle); GWM's April release said ~430 km. Both grades on 18-inch wheels

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: km77 WLTP combined 15.5 kWh/100km; GWM AU page also 15.5. Battery/range = 13.4, gap is charging losses

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: GWM AU 'up to 362L'; method not stated (assumed to the cover). km77 Spain lists 422 L, likely including underfloor; no frunk added

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: CarExpert spec page 1,060 L seats down; EV Database NZ same

towKg.note: GWM AU launch release: 750 kg braked and unbraked; CarExpert spec page 750 kg braked

warrantyYears.note: 7 years/unlimited km vehicle, unconditional; battery 8 years/unlimited km for private buyers

insuranceAnnual.note: held value kept; matches byd-atto2-dynamic ($31,990, $1,300), above geely-ex2-inspire ($30,990, $1,250)

depreciationCurve.note: GWM brand convention as recorded in gwm-cannon-phev provenance (also gwm-cannon-alpha-phev); held curve [1,0.7,0.59,0.51,0.44,0.38] replaced to keep one curve per brand. Haval H6/H6 GT and Tank rows still carry other curves, flagged to orchestrator. Ora hatch withdrawn after weak sales supports a below-mainstream curve
